correctness.rationale: All transition rates are strictly positive. Exact generator stationarity gives hot–hot pair correlations zero and a scalar tridiagonal Dirichlet recurrence on each cold run. The mean heat injection is its two boundary correlations times J; each yields the continued fraction a_l. The map a->alpha/(1-alpha a) has a positive attracting fixed point and strictly decaying positive increments, giving strict subadditivity and all equality cases by splitting and balancing. A separate exact-rational spin-state generator check and a rational pair-system solver verify finite cases; this does not replace the all-size proof. All quantitative normalizations and boundary exclusions are stated.

value.rationale: A motivated transport design problem is solved for every finite ring: with fixed numbers of hot and cold reservoirs, exact nonlocal heat throughput depends only on cold run lengths; strictly concave run response yields all sharp extrema and precise equality families. This is a scalable structural result, not a routine numerical recomputation or an arbitrary selected size, with direct benchmark utility for spatial patterning of thermal contacts.
